author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
How much does the subscription fee the SAAS company charge its customers?  

Probably 2x of the token cost it takes Claude Code to reverse engineer and implement the same thing from scratch. 

Why 2x?  You want to run Opus 4.6 and GPT-5. 4 in parallel and let them cross check each other's work.
